gaps.sentence: In no way ___ this report reflect the views of the editor.
gaps.explanation: In no way does this reflect… — formal disclaimer structure.

gaps.sentence: On no account ___ passengers open this door.
gaps.explanation: On no account should passengers… — formal prohibition.

gaps.sentence: In no way ___ this decision reflect the views of the board.
gaps.explanation: 'In no way does this decision reflect …' — auxiliary 'does' + base verb.

gaps.sentence: Rarely ___ this metro line run this late.
gaps.explanation: Rarely at the front: does + subject + infinitive.

gaps.sentence: Only by chance ___ the letters discovered decades later.
gaps.explanation: 'Only by chance were the letters discovered' — inverted passive.

gaps.sentence: Not once ___ the defendant change his statement.
gaps.explanation: Not once has he changed… — emphatic negative with present perfect.

gaps.sentence: Not only ___ the tickets expensive, but they were also sold out.
gaps.explanation: Not only were the tickets… — inversion with 'be' needs no auxiliary.

gaps.sentence: Only in an emergency ___ this exit be used.
gaps.explanation: may + be + participle: this exit may be used only in an emergency.
